clue.text: If nobbled when following the flag, "Don't tell him, Pike!"

indicators.note: the words after this phrase come after the flag in the answer

indicators.note: nobbled means tampered with, so the two letters of 'If' are rearranged

parts.note: SH is the hushing sound for keeping something quiet

explanation.surface: A quotation of the famous Dad's Army line, Captain Mainwaring scolding Private Pike, set beside a nobbled racehorse and a flag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nobbled' turns IF into FI. "Don't tell him, Pike!" is a catchphrase from the British TV sitcom Dad's Army, so 'Pike' looks like a name; here it is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The pike is a predatory freshwater fish, also called a jackfish in North America.
